records.subject: Need to construct fly-over at the crossing point of NH-31c (Now NH-117) at Karigaon, Shyamtaibari, Kashikotra, Sundary, Bengtal Gate in North East region.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Rwngwra Narzary:

The national highway plays an important protagonist as a vital economic corridor for the growth of a nation. There are 39 National High Way in Assam connecting important cities of Assam. Among them the earth-while NH-31c (now NH-117) National High Way is a most important road that connect mainland India with north-eastern region bound to south-east Asia starting from West Bengal. Stretching 235 KM, this National High-Way starts from Naxalbari, West Bengal and terminate at the junction with NH-31(now NH-27) at Rakaldubi near Bijni. It is noteworthy to say that, recently this earth-while NH-31c (now NH-117) has been developed from two-lane to four -lane road enabling transportation   safer, faster, smooth and seamless movement.  On the other side, there are several crossing points which are very vulnerable to occur accident that I want to bring some points to the notice of the Government.   These vulnerable crossing points are :  No.1.  ?Karigaon? gateway to Kokrajhar, head quarter of Bodoland,  No.2. ?Syamtaibari? gateway to Gelepu, Bhutan,  No.3.  Kashikotra, gateway to Basugaon town and rail station,  No.4 Sundary and Bengtal gate near Bongaigaon Refinery. The above-mentioned crossing points have been causing inconvenience to the public for seamless movement besides loss of lives due to frequent accident occurred there.  Therefore, I urge upon the Government to look into the matter and take steps to construct Fly-over in those crossing points.

 (ENDS)

records.subject: Need to include 'Kokrajhar', the capital of Bodoland, in the Smart City Mission of Government of India.
Demand to construct flyover at the Railway Crossing at Udalguri, Tangla and Goreswar town in Bodoland Territorial Region, Assam.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Rwngwra Narzary: The Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) was created through the signing of MoU agreement between ABSU (All Bodo Students Union) and other associate organisations like NDFB (National Democratic Front of Bodoland) and UBPO (United Bodo People?s Organization) in 2020. One of the objectives of the Accord was to ensure accelerated development of tribal areas.? The commitment for construction of flyover at Udalguri and Tangla in Udalguri district and Goreswar in Tamulpur district at the Railway crossing falling in the BTR was laid in the clause No.10.1 of the BTR accord, 2020.? Udalguri is a district headquarter bifurcated by the railway tracts into two parts. Students, business community and publics are to crossed the Railway gate losing real time movement for their business. The construction of flyover at the railway crossing is necessary for seamless movement of public, students and business community for their daily business avoiding provable incidents.? The Tangla and the Goreswar town Railway gates cause lots of trouble to commuters which lead to traffic jam affecting seamless movement. Sometime students are to miss out exam time due to unable to cross the railway gate in time. Considering the importance of flyover in those places, demands for its construction was inserted in the annexure-iv of the accord which is to be sanctioned by the Government of India. Therefore, I urge upon the Government to take measures to construct those three flyovers at the railway crossing and fulfil the needs of the public as committed in the BTR accord.

(ENDS)

records.subject: Demand to complete approval process of the BGR, project expansion in Assam.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Rwngwra Narzary: Bongaigaon Refinery (BGR) located in the district of Chirang, Bodoland Territorial Region has tirelessly served this nation since 1974 and has been fueling the growth engine of the province of Assam and state of India. Under the Hydro carbon Vision 2030 then MoS for MoPNG announced Government of Indias decision to finance and support BGR expansion from 2.7 MMTPA to 5 MMTPA on 17th? November 2021 at BGR auditorium during the celebration of Azadi Ki Amrit Mahotsav. This declaration was well received and was applauded by the peoples of Assam. Accordingly, we were hopeful that the process of approval of the BGR expansion project would be completed and the foundation laying ceremony for BGR would also be done along with the foundation of Digboi Refinery on the last 9 March,2024.? So, BTC Government expedited land allotment process and allotment letter issued to IOCL for 532 Bigha land and propose to offer additional 300 Bighas land and requested IOCL for consent. But it is a matter of concern that till now the approval process after MOS statement has not completed. BGR?s sustainability will depend on the timely intervention by the Ministry of MoPNG. As FY 2023-24 was fixed as outlook for completion of expansion of BGR, I request the Minister of Petroleum & Natural gas to intervene immediately on approval process and save a famous and legacy refinery from ending for the interest of the people of Assam.

(Ends)

records.subject: Upgradation of Air Kokrajhar at par AIR Guwahati and establishment of a branch of news unit for broadcast of news in the Bodo language under Regional News Unit (RNU), AIR Guwahati
records.SM_Text:
Shri Rwngwra Narzary : All India Radio, Kokrajhar commissioned on 15th August, 1999 with Bodo as the link language is the only programme originating station of lower Assam situated at Kokrajhar, capital of the Bodoland Territorial Region. Since then, this station has been continuing to produce and broadcast programmes in various formats in Bodo, Assamese and other dialects. The main purpose for establishment of this station was to bring upliftment of the vibrant culture of the Bodos and other communities and impart educative and informative knowledge to the people inhabitated in its jurisdiction. Bodo is one of the 22 languages included in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution and Associate official language of Assam and widely spoken language, particularly in the Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR). So, giving due respect and importance to the Bodo language and progress of cultures and literatures of all sections of the communities within its jurisdiction, it is quite desirable to upgrade the AIR Kokrajhar at per capital stations. As the Bodo Language is the widely spoken language within the jurisdiction of AIR Kokrajhar, it will be very beneficial for the listeners, if a branch of news unit is established under the Regional News Unit (RNU), AIR Guwahati, for broadcast of news items in Bodo. This will help the Bodo knowing people in better understanding of circulated information and news items. So, I urge upon the Minister of Information and Broadcasting to take measures for upgradation of AIR, Kokrajhar at par with AIR, Guwahati and establishment of a branch of News Unit at AIR Kokrajhar.

(Ends)
